name: autoesperto
description: AutoEsperto — il consulente AI italiano per acquistare auto usate

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/database && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.db:postgres: copy packages\database\prisma\schema.postgresql.prisma packages\database\prisma\schema.prisma /y && echo Copiato schema PostgreSQL. Metti DATABASE_URL in .env e lancia npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:push: npm run db:generate --workspace=packages/database && npx prisma db push --schema=packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
